about: v2 M6 synthetic day (docs/plans/v2-partition-1.md, Measurements). Times are local HH:MM[:SS] on `date`: user items come in 8 conversations (3-6 items, 2-3 min apart, 85-115 min between them), signals arrive on their own (4 inside a conversation), each child follows the user item that spawns it within a minute, the night run is late. `tools`: the item needs a tool. `approve_after_s`: the item gates (write_file) and the user approves that many seconds later. The world is fake_notion's, written to workspace/notion/ in the temp home. `user_md` is written as the temp home's USER.md and `agenda` stands for the senses' agenda lines: with the clock line they make the resident block. All fake values.
user_md:
# USER
- 가상 사용자: a fake profile for the M6 bench, no real person
- 대학교 3학년; 이번 학기 강의 8주 과정, 기말고사 준비 중
- Answers: short, in Korean by default, technical terms in English
- Deep work 09:00-11:00 and 14:00-16:00; keep those slots free when planning
- Exercises in the evening; one knee is sensitive, so prefer low-impact routines
- Notion pages are exported to notion/ in the workspace; daily notes go to notes/
- 가계부 is updated every Sunday evening
- Study group meets on Tuesdays and Thursdays
- Likes a three-line summary at the end of the day
- Never send or post anything on the user's behalf without asking first
